subject: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - ATL / 208 CTN 5,200 KGS
body:
Hi,

Could you quote one all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option to YYZ (Toronto, CA)? The printed marketing material is ready for pickup on 2026-12-05 at our site in 21107 (Lueneburg), Germany. Please arrange the truck to the airport.

Lot 1: 2 cartons, each 474 kg gross (445 kg net), each 120 x 80 x 119 cm
Lot 2: 7 drums, each 32 kg gross (28 kg net), each 110 x 110 x 103 cm
Lot 3: 2 pallets, together 726 kg gross (646 kg net), together 4.33 cbm

Please ship all lots together as a single consignment under one air waybill.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-08
Subject: VIENNA AIRPORT - ATL / 208 CTN 5,200 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex VIENNA AIRPORT to ATL:
208 CTN / 5,200 KGS / 4 CBM, machine parts
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer requests a new all-in quote for air freight to Toronto and pickup arrangements.
